clauses.title: Registry evidence
clauses.text: Approved supplier status must be supported by a current supplier registry record at the evaluation time.

clauses.title: Exact identity matching
clauses.text: Supplier approval must use the confirmed supplier identifier. Similar names must not be treated as the same supplier.

clauses.title: Part-level evidence
clauses.text: Electronics purchases require current RoHS evidence matching both the supplier identifier and requested manufacturer part number.

clauses.title: Missing evidence
clauses.text: Missing, expired, or mismatched RoHS evidence requires review and must not be inferred from document similarity.

clauses.title: Approval threshold
clauses.text: A proposed award with total landed cost of SGD 10,000 or more requires manager approval before publication.

clauses.title: Approval evidence
clauses.text: Approval evidence must identify the approving actor, amount, timestamp, and task revision.

clauses.title: Frozen exchange rate
clauses.text: Foreign-currency quotes may be compared only with an approved exchange-rate snapshot effective at the evaluation timestamp.

clauses.title: Conversion precision
clauses.text: Converted totals use Decimal arithmetic and ROUND_HALF_UP to two decimal places after native total cost is calculated.

clauses.title: Buyer-confirmed preference
clauses.text: A ranking preference, tie-break rule, or cost tolerance must be confirmed by the buyer before it changes supplier selection.

clauses.title: Hard constraints first
clauses.text: Package, revision, condition, budget, and delivery deadline are hard constraints and are evaluated before ranking preferences.

clauses.title: Unknown charges
clauses.text: An unknown material charge remains unknown and must never be normalized to zero.

clauses.title: Decision impact
clauses.text: Missing information blocks publication when a feasible value could change the recommended supplier; otherwise its non-impact must be proven by deterministic analysis.
